messages.subject: Error:  * Unable to deploy package dependency 'rstudio'
parts:
I am trying to deploy an app and I get this error:

Error:  * Unable to deploy package dependency 'rstudio'
The package was installed locally from source. Only packages installed from
  CRAN, BioConductor and GitHub are supported.

I don't understand this dependency, I didn't even know there was an R package called rstudio.

What can I do?

I think I am getting this error now that I have updated my RStudio IDE.
Best

messages.author: 5244788d054d6394
messages.subject: Re: Error:  * Unable to deploy package dependency 'rstudio'
parts:
My bad...

I did find a reference to the function rstudio::viewer() in my code.
I removed it and was able to deploy.

Cheers
